/extensions/mode_state/ball_save_state.note: Fan-patch code at 0xFCE1; 2.08 has no such save.

/extensions/mode_state/balls_per_game_li.note: Medium confidence; not varied against the operator menu.

/extensions/mode_state/freeway_extra_bal.note: Named 0x16F1 and 0x16F2 by one source; the rig image holds 0x23 against the changelog's 17.

/extensions/mode_state/freeway_next_awar.note: Table at 0xB0F5; counts against values not checked in the rig.

/extensions/mode_state/freeway_ramps.note: Supersedes a 5 Sep reading as 'jackpot level'.

/extensions/mode_state/replays_this_game.note: Supersedes a 5 Sep reading as 'double jackpot armed'.

/extensions/replay_levels.note: 0xDF60 computes 5i; four levels per the four replay audits.

/extensions/sound_commands.note: Per-command grade in each note; captures before 5 Sep 2026 are lw3_208.

/memory_map/adjustments.note: Each byte tied to its menu entry by the code that reads or writes it.

/memory_map/adjustments/Standard Adjustm.note: Tournament Mode exists only in the 3.01 patch.

/memory_map/audits.note: Names are the display ROM's; addresses derived and validated over 0x1D14-0x1DE0 by multi-counter routines and a rig run.

/memory_map/game_state.note: tomlogic's fields; current_player, current_ball, player_count and credits also read correctly on lw3_301 in the rig.

/memory_map/game_state/bonus.note: Paid = BCD x 10,000 x multiplier, 3 of 3 predictions.

addressing.basis: Data East keeps its 8 KB RAM at CPU 0x0000-0x1FFF and Controller.NVRAM returns it from index 0 (8238 bytes with a trailer); tomlogic's offsets read correctly unshifted and wrong when shifted by 46 (rig, lw3_301).

ball_save_state._notes: 0x01 armed, 0x09 expired, bit 7 spent; seconds left = 10 - BCD(0x0813) while 0x01.
ball_save_state.label: Start-of-ball save state

drop_bank_completions._notes: Any bank in any order: 1st sets 0x1400+0x1403, 2nd 0x1401+0x1404, 3rd 0x1402+0x1405 and 0x1019.
drop_bank_completions.label: Drop-bank completions

freeway_extra_ball_target._notes: 0 when the limit or lamp 40 forbids it. The same source also names 0x16F2; unresolved.
freeway_extra_ball_target.label: Ramps needed for EXTRA BALL LIT

freeway_next_award_at.label: Ramp count of the next ramp award

freeway_next_award_code.label: Code of the next ramp award

leo_award._notes: Final about 50 ms after 0x10A4 rises; 0 is real only with the 0x1D24 audit step.
leo_award.label: Leo Getz award index

lw_latches._notes: Each byte: 0x80 next, 0x01 collected, 0x00 idle. 0x8F82 arms 0x1407 on the LW1 collect; 0x8FB7 arms 0x1408 on the LW2 collect.
lw_latches.label: Lethal Weapon 1/2/3 collect latches

multiball_gate._notes: 0x81 while multiball runs; entry 0x7A8F needs 0 here and 0x1019 non-zero.
multiball_gate.label: Multiball gate

stunt_rung._notes: Between stunts: stunts completed this ball, next = value + 1 wrapping 6 to 1. During a stunt: the current rung.
stunt_rung.label: Stunt rung

notes: Uzi clip count, Million Plus count and the Getaway hurry-up value have no RAM byte found; likely task-local (inferred).
0x0183 is a byte staged for the display board; earlier meanings drawn from it were retracted after watching play.

sound_commands.label_source: Labels are the Total Recall project's names (mus_, sfx_, voc_, ctl_, sys_; unk_ = never heard in play, _dup = duplicate audio); each note gives that project's evidence grade.

notes: Written at 0x46AD from 0x0184; a byte equal to the last one sent (0x0185) or equal to 0xFF is suppressed.
A routine plays a sound by posting a display record [count, id, parameter, duration]; the command is its parameter.

_notes: Lethal Weapon 3 [Data East, 1992]: tomlogic's lw3_208 map (version 9) extended by pinmame-game-defs.
game_state and high_scores below come from tomlogic unchanged, except the four game_state keys added here.

04._notes: Any other value awards a credit.
04.label: Game Awards

39._notes: 3.01 meaning; on 2.08 this entry is Next Game Promo.
39.label: Tournament Mode

Standard Adjustments._notes: Keys are the operations manual's menu numbers as read by the contributor (Ad 01 to E Ad 56), not re-checked here.

Feature Audits._notes: Keys are indices into the display ROM's audit-name table (lw3drom1.300, 0x163E9), not menu numbers; address = 0x1D4C + 4 x (index - 58), validated over 0x1D14-0x1DE0 only.

bonus._notes: Unmultiplied end-of-ball bonus in units of 10,000; zeroed the moment it is paid.
bonus.label: Bonus

game_over._notes: game is over if current player/ball is 0
game_over.label: Game Over
